# Code Bench full documentation

Source: https://codebench.trfny.com/

Description: Complete LLM-oriented description of the Code Bench browser application.

## Code Bench

Code Bench is a local-first QR code and barcode studio. User-entered payloads are processed in the browser rather than uploaded to a Code Bench backend.

### QR codes

- Create plain and styled QR codes.
- Build structured Wi-Fi, contact and calendar/event payloads.
- Customize modules, corners, palettes, frames and logos.
- Export raster and vector variants, including PNG and SVG.

### Barcodes

- Generate common one-dimensional and two-dimensional barcode formats.
- Supported families include Code 128, EAN, Data Matrix, Aztec and PDF417.
- Scan supported codes from images or a browser camera where HTTPS and permissions allow it.

### Privacy and portability

The normal application keeps user payloads in browser state. A portable build is available for local/offline use. Camera scanning requires explicit browser permission.

### Agent access

On browser hosts that implement WebMCP, the application exposes `read_code_state`, `set_qr_code`, `set_barcode` and `export_code`. Tool calls operate on the visible UI state.
